messages.content: The Friday morning rights meeting has been reassigned to the Hyatt Regency Chicago. Does it make sense to move from the Central Loop Hotel before the cancellation cutoff?

Probably not. The Hyatt is roughly a 20-minute walk from Central Loop, so relocating would mainly save that walk on Friday morning. Central Loop remains convenient for the Palmer House sessions, while moving would require changing the reservation and likely paying a different rate.
So there is no meaningful reason to alter the hotel booking? The flights have not changed.

Correct. Keep the Central Loop reservation and allow about 25 minutes to reach the Hyatt on Friday morning. The time saved by moving for one meeting is too small to justify disrupting the stay, and no flight action is needed. If plans change, cancel without penalty by 6:00 p.m. Chicago time on March 26.
